scientific_integrity.claim_proven: Support size at most seven forces unique medianity of an integer mean for all contiguous-support discrete log-concave laws; eight is the sharp first failure size.
scientific_integrity.known_component: The eight-point truncated geometric counterexample is explicitly given in Alqasem et al., arXiv:2208.12702; the log-affine extremal theorem is Marsiglietti and Melbourne, arXiv:2004.12005.
scientific_integrity.limitations: Requires finite consecutive support and integer expectation; does not classify noninteger means, infinite supports or quantitative probability margins.
scientific_integrity.priority_risk: Earlier equivalent minimal-support theorem cannot be excluded; a 2024 related dissertation was accessible at abstract/metadata level only.
scientific_integrity.validation: Same-model analytic review and exact-rational certificate; independent audit not performed.

title: Eight is the sharp support threshold for failure of integer-mean medianity under discrete log-concavity
